items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I went in that band behind Happy... So, I got in that band and I played with that band

ctx.x: Okay, I see you were just finishing up about the Eureka Band, I guess.

Eureka Band, well, in our T-Boy, he was a trumpet, and like I say, the trumpet was where the little Jim playing bass from. I'm getting to the bass from a little Jim, and they had Happy playing the snare from over the river. Bill's brother, Happy.
